enunciado: An Order computes its shipping cost by delegating to an interchangeable ShippingStrategy: StandardShipping (5 + 2 per kg), ExpressShipping (15 + 3 per kg) and FreeShipping (0). Change the strategy at run time for a 4 kg order.
objetivos: Encapsulate interchangeable algorithms behind an abstraction
Prefer composition over conditionals on the type
pistas: The Order does not know which concrete strategy it uses.
Adding a new strategy does not require touching Order.
Remember: ShippingStrategy e = this.strategy; return e.cost(...);
